answer_1.quote: We conduct extensive cross-lingual transfer experiments on XL‑Sum for abstractive summarisation in six typologically diverse languages... We also conduct human evaluations to corroborate these results.

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE‑1/2/L scores to evaluate the task of abstractive summarisation. We use the four metrics mentioned in Section 2 to evaluate the faithfulness of English summaries and our mFACT metric for summaries in other languages.

answer_4.quote: We recruited human annotators from the Prolific platform for a blind comparison between MAD‑X and our weighted‑loss model... We asked the human participants to evaluate the summaries via A/B testing in two aspects, Informativeness... Faithfulness.
answer_4.guideline: Participants read the document and select the better summary (or both) in terms of informativeness and faithfulness.
